title: Trace line v1
description: One JSON line per LLM call (D9, D12). Measurement fields are filled by the recorder and absent in traces made only for replay.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema; a reader rejects lines of a version it does not know.

run_id.description: Same value as the x-run-id header of the call.

task_type.description: Kind of agent task; expected_steps is derived per task type.

step.description: 1-based index of the call within the run.

expected_steps.description: Number of calls this task type usually needs (D1).

parallel_group.description: Same value as the x-parallel-group header; absent for sequential calls.

gap_before_ms.description: Time between the end of the previous call of the run and the start of this one (tool time, D9); 0 for the first call.

ts_start.description: Start of the call in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

duration_ms.description: Time from sending the request to receiving the full response.

pod.description: Name of the pod that served the call.
